name: The sea off Arpoador

looks.night: after sunset in Rio until sunrise (rain at night shows night)

states.start: quiet: Arpoador's granite face with barnacles, mussels and two anemones, the coral reef, two sargassum plants, the granite arch, the paddleboard at the surface, a little group of sardines and three reef fish; the octopus's eyes in its crevice
states.full: busy: a big sardine shoal, two green turtles, a spotted eagle ray and a stingray in the sand, the octopus out on the crevice lip, more kelp and seagrass, more corals, sponges, sea fans, anemones, starfish, urchins, a crab, nine reef fish and bubbles

foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the sticker frame (16x16); draw at left = x - 8, top = y - 15
draw_order: sort stickers by foot y (then x), back to front, over the base and the caustics overlay
sticker_looks: recolour placed stickers by colour name with looks/palette-rain.json / palette-night.json, as the other Rio areas do
swim_note: swim slots are free-swimming: the game may bob a fish 1 px or drift it a few px left and right; no shadow. Rock and sand slots sit; the game may add a 1 px sand shadow

showcase.note: the rare-fish showcase: under the granite arch, on a pale sand clearing ringed with white stones, in its own sunbeam (a cyan glow ring at night). For the workbook-complete legendaries (one per whole workbook). Until one is earned the clearing stays empty; the ghost of a not-yet-earned legendary may show here

exits.note: swim up: back to the beach by Arpoador

player.who: Esme snorkelling (the player; drawn by the app, not baked)
player.draw: left = x - 26, top = y - 18; above stickers; 4 frames at 180 ms
player.note: just under the surface by the paddleboard's nose, face down, snorkel up through the surface. Her dive torch is lit at night: the warm pool round it is baked into the night bases

friend.draw: left = x - 16, top = y - 31 (y per state and look: the deck's top); recolour by name for rain and night like stickers; his hat / neck accessory sheets line up with the same frame
friend.note: Mr Cat sits on the paddleboard, facing left, looking down at Esme
